name: Nvidia
rationale: NVDA is the only candidate that cleanly clears my multi-horizon long-only trend screen in the state feed, with 1W +1.99%, 1M +3.94%, and 3M +3.61%, while volatility is relatively contained at 2.46% daily. It also has fresh catalysts: NVIDIA announced Japan’s first national AI infrastructure on July 16 and a $500B-plus SK Group partnership on July 24, and its next earnings are not until August 26,
